title: Certificates of Deposit: when a penalty that fails the rate or days check is reversed, and for how much
content:
## Scope

This rule decides, for a Certificates of Deposit early withdrawal penalty compared with the rate and the penalty days the charter fixes for its term, whether the penalty is reversed and what amount is credited back.

## Rule

1. **Tolerance on the rate.** A penalty whose rate applied differs from the rate the charter fixes by more than 0.001 percentage point was booked at the wrong rate.
2. **Days.** A penalty whose penalty days differ from the charter penalty days was booked at the wrong number of days.
3. **Either failure is enough.** A penalty booked at the wrong rate, or at the wrong number of days, or both, is reversed with the adjustment reason bank error, for its whole booked amount, never in part.
4. **Amount.** The reversal amount is the booked penalty amount to the cent, with no further rounding and no recalculation.
5. **A matching penalty.** A penalty that matches both the charter rate and the charter penalty days is not reversed, and nothing is written.
6. **Once only.** A penalty that already has a penalty reversal entry pointing to it is not reversed again.

## Truth table

| Rate differs by more than 0.001 point | Penalty days differ | Already reversed | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes or No | No | Reverse the whole booked amount |
| No | Yes | No | Reverse the whole booked amount |
| No | No | No | Not reversed; nothing written |
| Yes or No | Yes or No | Yes | Not reversed again |

## Witness cases (hypothetical figures)

Charter rate 3.80 percent and charter penalty days 90; booked penalty 61.27.

| Booked rate applied | Booked penalty days | Difference in rate | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3.805 | 90 | 0.005, more than 0.001 | Reverse 61.27 |
| 3.8005 | 90 | 0.0005, not more than 0.001 | Rate matches; days match; nothing written |
| 3.801 | 90 | exactly 0.001, not more than 0.001 | Rate matches; days match; nothing written |
| 3.80 | 7 | none | Days differ; reverse 61.27 |

## Wrong reading and correct basis

| Wrong reading | Correct basis |
|---|---|
| Only the excess of the booked penalty over a correctly computed penalty is credited back. | The whole booked amount is reversed, never in part. |
| The booked amount is recomputed and rounded before it is credited. | It is credited to the cent as booked, with no further rounding. |
